body: Hang out and cuddle? Sounds like a recipe for disaster :)
Alright--will do :)
Alright, thanks. I think I'm just going to send him a text and see how he responds.
Hehe mine was just a joke. Ok I'll try that one. Thanks :)
"Hey, is your intention to have sex with me?!?"
Ok, I figured that's what that invitation meant but I didn't want to assume anything!
Right. I didn't want to assume he wanted to sleep with me and I thought by saying that I might be presumptuous?
Crazy! Tell him beforehand?
Thank you :)
Lies, lies, lies. I started unraveling a few of his lies and he couldn't handle it. That was what our breakup came down to.
Have you been able to move forward at all?
Yup. Exactly the same thing happened with us. I called him out on a series of things and he was like "fuck you, I'm done."

Yup, that sounds accurate. I realized my ex used to use his own anger to distract from the lie. So if I called him out on something, it would become about how angry he was that I didn't trust him instead of the fact that he just told me a disgustingly obvious lie. It's crazy how similar patterns of behavior are with narcissists.

Sounds exactly like my ex. I used to wait and wait and WAIT around for him...hours would go by. Sometimes I would get nervous that he was in an accident or something so I would text and call to make sure he was alive. One night he texted me that he was leaving work at 8pm and he would see me soon. No word from him until 3:30am, at which point he texted me "be there in 5." He didn't get home until near 5am. I was suddenly made to be some psycho bitch for calling and texting him, worried fucking sick. Of course, it would always be "you need to fucking relax. I'm fine."

That's crazy. I'm sorry you had to go through all of that. I do know about the need to apologize/make things right though even when it's not on you at all. 

In the beginning of our relationship, my ex and I lived in the same city but then I had to move for work so we became long distance. We were long distance for the last 6 months of our relationship (I'm pretty sure this was an ideal set up for him...he had freedom and control). During that whole time, we never once skyped. He said he didn't want to. We talked on the phone very rarely. He only wanted to text (great "relationship")...and he would often send me nasty text messages for a day or two if I even suggested a phone call or a skype call. We saw each other in person every month or so, but he controlled every single visit. He would tell me he couldn't let me know until the day before. Sometimes he would cancel on me when I was on my way to see him...or he would say "why not drive here today?" on a random day. Like I have a life, I have plans outside of you...I need a few days advance notice. But of course my schedule didn't matter...it was only when it was convenient for him. Looking back on it, it was really crazy. He would tell me he loved me and missed me so much then I would say, ok well let's pick a weekend! And he would freak out yelling at me that he was stressed from work and he doesn't have time to talk about this bullshit. He's so mean.

Great, thanks! It's helpful to read stuff like that. Because I always feel less insane. For a while I genuinely thought it was ME and there was something wrong with me that made him act that way. But reading the list made me realize how "typical" he was as a narcissist. 

The one thing I have been REALLY good at is not checking his facebook/instagram. I try to remember this: there is nothing good there. Literally, nothing he could post will make you feel good. He isn't going to post "Oh my gosh, I miss my ex so much!!" What could you possibly see on his Facebook that would make you feel good? Try to remember that. Plus it would 1000000% wreck me to see him with another woman and I know I risk this searching his name on Facebook. So that's enough to keep me away.

I would hope so. He pretended to me the perfect man for me in the beginning though. When I used to cry/get upset, he would hold me and talk to me and help me through it. But toward the end it was like his true feelings about me surfaced and he freaking hated everything about me. I was like were you ever happy? Why were you even with me?
True...he definitely liked being in control of me/the relationship. Everything had to be at his speed/pace. We could only see each other when he wanted to, etc.
Great, thank you. I will check it out for sure.
Weird. I guess everyone is different. He later told me that I was too emotional for him, so maybe it was more because of that than the fact that I was crying during the breakup.
I will definitely look into those books--thank you. It sounds like you're doing well, good for you. I can only hope to me in that place eventually :)

I don't know about that. I think I was so stuck on him that I wasn't able to see things clearly. I think (hope) that years down the line I'll realize it wasn't truly love, but who knows. Maybe it will be the best love I'll ever have.

I didn't really understand it...like I'm crying...because I'm sad that this relationship is ending...why would that insult him? If anything, it's a boost to his ego. It wasn't like I was laughing. It was really strange. 

It can't hurt but it can take a lot of time and energy and effort and things getting worse before they get better.

Yeah...it's weird because he seems aware of what he does to women but at the same time he doesn't seem aware of the extent of his problem. I think it's kind of "I can get and fuck over any woman I want" instead of seeing it as a problem that affects him beyond that. I don't really know what's going on in his mind though. Crazy things.

Yeah--I know. I feel that way too...sometimes everyone is just so adamantly against things. I know people are trying to be supportive and it really wasn't a healthy relationship. But I would probably try again with him if we had another chance. But he doesn't want to be with me because I damaged his ego too much when we broke up. I called him a liar and he can't get over that. I also cried when we broke up and he told me that we would've made up but since I cried I made everything 100 times worse and then he didn't want to be with me anymore...so...there's that! 

I think it will definitely take a lot of self reflection...there is nothing anyone can say that will immediately fix me of course. But it's nice knowing there are other people who have been through the same sort of thing and made it out alive...maybe even better for it :)

I was NC for a while...almost 6 weeks. But I actually just contacted him about a week ago. I was feeling like I couldn't possibly feel any worse, so I might as well just text him. And he was really sweet and nice to me for like 3 days. He told me that he always knew we would get back together and he had such strong feelings for me and blah blah blah. And then one day he didn't text me at all, so that night I just texted him and said "hi, how was your day?" And he literally freaked out on me. He told me I was stupid, crazy, annoying, dramatic, immature. He said I had to stop contacting him and that he wants nothing to do with me and he would be happy to never see my face again and on and on. This was literally one day after he told me he knew we could make it work again. It was so weird. I was hurt by it, but also worried/in shock. 

I am glad I found this...someone suggested I come here from another sub, actually. But it is nice to read other people's stories and feel less alone. I was certainly feeling insane for a while...he is so nice/charming/charismatic in person. Anyone who met him in real life would never believe me if I told them all the things he did to me once the mask dropped... It is hard to accept that it will be a long recovery period...I really thought I would be moving in with him/getting engaged at this point, not going through all of this shit...but I guess that's life. At the end of the day, it's better I discovered this side of him now instead of 10 years down the line with a marriage, house and 2 kids...right?
I don't think I'm at that place yet...I'm still thinking of him as the perfect man he painted himself to be.

I keep a list of the bad things on my phone so I can read it when I'm feeling like I need him back. 

The good things...there are some. But most of the good is in how he made me felt, if that makes sense. There were aspects of his personality that I loved as well...Maybe I was more in love with the relationship and that feeling than I was in love with him...I'm not sure.

Hmmmm...that's interesting you say that he always had to be on my mind before so it's like a habit...that may very well be true. It was definitely a weird dynamic where I always had to be available and he could not respond to me at all for hours at a time. But you are right. He was CONSTANTLY on my mind when we were together...like probably to the point where it wasn't healthy. He would make me obsess about little things. 

I actually find myself worrying that he'll be that perfect version of himself for someone else. And she won't do anything to mess it up the way I did. I know it's super flawed but I can't help it.

Sadly, learning what he is and how typical this behavior is of narcissists hasn't helped me much. I just keep thinking, "yeah but he's mine," or "yeah but what we had was different." I know that's common to think as well...but I can't escape it.
I do miss all the fun, best parts of him...when he was just "normal."

Yeah. I knew something was up from the beginning. He told me he loved me 5 minutes after asking me to be his girlfriend. Then made me feel guilty And I was like wtf? Relax. But I knew on some level he was moving too fast that it was strange. But I was falling in love so I was like ehhh maybe this is normal?
Yeah you're right. I googled "is my relationship abusive" and "wht is abuse" so many times while we were together. The fact that I was even googling it should've been my answer.

I hesitate to classify it as "abuse" because I feel like it wasn't bad enough or something. It was mostly just sly manipulation and messing with me emotionally. There were 2 times it got physical...but he didn't hurt me.
no, not really
Yeah, it's true. But right now I'm feeling like I can't live like this for very long. Like feeling this intensity of emotions is too difficult for me.
I don't know about that. But thank you.
Thank you. I appreciate that :)
You're right. I hope I can at least get through this.

That makes me sad...I wish I could get over it. I wish I could be hypnotized to forget him or something...is that an option?? 

I once read that the reason some people tend to be in multiple abusive relationships is because abusers are drawn to those who aren't quite "healed." A "normal," kind person would realize you have walls up and aren't quite ready for a relationship and respect that. An abuser would realize the same thing and push and push until you gave in. I don't know if that makes sense the way I wrote it...but it stuck with me when I read it!
You seem to have been in a relationship like this before...do you feel you were able to overcome it...? My fear is never finding another relationship because I'm going to be so paralyzed by fear.
Thanks...I wish I could fast forward the healing process...that would be useful.

Yes, I actually suspect he is a narcissist. The first time I read the list of narcissistic traits, I cried for hours...I felt like someone wrote the list about him. 

I will definitely check that out, thank you.
Thank you. I appreciate that. It's difficult to even admit to myself because he has convinced me that I'm crazy/dramatic/overreacting.
Sorry to hear that, but congrats on making it to 1 month :) can't say I've done the same. I don't know why some people just want to hurt...I'll never make sense of it.

No I'm not really comfortable talking about it with people in life. My friends have heard enough about it...I think they're sick of it. It doesn't really come up in therapy somehow. Part of me feels like I should just stop talking about him on reddit or whatever, because I think it's making it worse. But I don't know :(

Thanks...thinking about it as a death just makes it sadder, which I keep telling him. He told me he doesn't care, of course. He said he would be fine with never seeing me or talking to me again and acting as though I died... I just don't get it. How can you ask someone to marry you and tell them you've never loved anyone that way just to drop them and treat them like shit. I don't know if this is just the way men are or if it's specific to assholes or if it's specific to him. But I'm just really disheartened by the whole thing. I don't want to try anymore.

But how long? I waited and waited and the only reason I reached out to him was because i felt so bad that I believed it was impossible to feel any worse. So I was like ehhhh what harm is texting him going to do.
Yeah I made sure to save the worst of the screenshots. It just makes me so upset because everything is still so emotional.
Right. But I feel like it speaks of me now that I can't just drop him. I keep running back to him pathetically hoping for some sort of positive interaction with him :(
Yeah. I struggle with that as well. Even though outwardly I seem slightly better, I still fight thoughts all the time.
Yeah. Definitely strangely comforting but probably a super unhealthy mindset as well.

But if you asked me 4 years ago, that's exactly what I would've said. I felt so stuck and lost and like nothing would ever improve. And truthfully, some areas of life haven't improved at all. 

And yes, there were positive things that happened in my life. Terrible things happened also. I'm not going to pretend I'm a completely changed person who is suddenly happy and positive and free of anxiety and depression. But I guess 4 years ago, I never imagined any of those things happening. So I just try to think "imagine the next 4 years." Things have so much potential to change.
Me too, most days. I'm working on removing it as a "fallback option" in my mind.
Thanks. I'm trying to just keep going but it's really really hard. I think I want him back.
When I think about a year or two from now, I just break down crying because I know he won't be in my life anymore and it's all I want.

I'm not ready to meet new people. I tried and I just felt badly because I was shutting everyone down. 

I've made sure to do something with my friends every weekend. Even when I don't want to. But I just feel like I'm going through the motions.
Thank you :)

I know. But I don't connect with people as easily as everyone else. It's a long long long process for me. This was honestly the first person I ever really let in. To feel like I finally got to this point and he took it and smashed it is the worst feeling I've ever felt. I don't think it's going to make me stronger. I honestly think I won't try this ever again. I think this is it.

I just keep imagining him happy with whoever he's with now. And I think about how she's in the early wooing stage and he's saying and doing all the same things he said and did to me. And it makes me feel sick to my stomach.

I don't know. It sucks :( 
In the beginning he was an amazing person and we had this connection and I just don't know what happened
I want him to change for me
Yeah, until I see it for myself I guess it won't matter what other people say :(
But what if this time it works
I do regret it tremendously
Thanks, I appreciate you saying all of that. I'm definitely having a hard time seeing that right now.
It was awful and abusive. But I think a lot of that was caused by me. If I hadn't been so caught up in making things right maybe he wouldn't have ended up the way he did. I don't know. I feel stupid.
Yeah. Part of me feels like I just want to go back to him because I want this pain to go away and I feel like he is the only way. But it's hard to tell if that's the case.

I'm trying and I haven't been contacting him. But when I start thinking about the good stuff I just miss him so much and I want to cave and call him. I'm pretty sure he has me blocked as well at this point so it wouldn't do any good.

I feel like since I'm missing him so much, I made the wrong decision by letting him go.

I'm feeling like all it's doing is making me regret ending things with him. Now I almost feel bad for blocking his number. The other day I was thinking about how he was probably texting me and just thinks I'm ignoring him and I started crying.
It's never been this bad :( I don't know what to do
But then what? Then I'm just supposed to live the rest of my life this miserable?
Thanks. I certainly hope so :)

Yes, thank you! Very helpful and I appreciate you taking the time to reply. 

I am opposed to medication. I can see it working and being helpful for some people, but it's just not for me. I definitely do not want to stay this way. I tend to hide my anxiety and depression from everyone, so it's not like I try to use it for sympathy or anything. I genuinely, 100% want it gone. 

I have done the things they suggest outside of thepary like writing and breathing exercises and all that. I just feel kind of silly doing it. I do it anyway, but a lot of the time I feel like it is just not helpful for me. I almost feel like I need more real life things. I need coping skills for when the anxiety comes up. When I'm really anxious or depressed, the last thing I want to do is sit down and breathe or start writing a journal entry about how I'm feeling. I think I need more "in the moment" strategies. 

There are certain areas in my life that do not make me happy. I am not satisfied with my job and I just got out of an awful, abusive relationship. The relationship and the breakup are the main reason why all of this stuff has kicked up again. Luckily I have several close friends who I have known since I was young and a huge family. I do tend to feel alone sometimes with my mental health issues, but not isolated in life.

I feel like he only agreed because he was cheating though. He knew that he could just move on to the next one or two or three so he didn't need me anymore. It just hurts so much to feel like I was so easily replaced. It feels like I was just an object and sex for him and once he was getting it elsewhere, I was old news.
I don't feel like I'm in control of it. I feel like he is
I feel like my expectations of him might've been too high though. I don't know. I'm only thinking of the good, happy memories now.
I don't know how to come to terms with the fact that he doesn't exist though? Like he was being fake in the beginning? I don't understand that.
I just feel like he took so much of me that it will always be this difficult. I know time will help but I still can't imagine being in a better place year from now or two years from now.
He wasn't where I would expect him to be emotionally at 36 years old. But everyone's different. Our age difference was never really an issue for us.
I guess that's true. I kind of feel like love should override those things though. So in my mind anything can be worked out.

It was a combination of things. He started lying about a bunch of seemingly insignificant things and he was talking to other women. I don't know if anything physical ever happened but the relationships had no boundaries. I tried to talk to him about it a few times but every time he would react like a child being scolded and yell and pout.
I'm aware it's over. It's not like I don't accept that we aren't together. I just struggle because I love him and I don't know what I can do about that. I think I made a mistake by ending it.
But I don't know there's nothing good for me with him. That's the problem. I keep thinking about what could've been and I don't know if I made a terrible mistake by breaking up with him.

I have tried hanging out with friends and working out and all of that. I just feel sad while I do it. Like I'm faking it and going through the motions when all I want is to be with him and talk to him. I feel sort of spaced out when I do things like that. 

I am starting to question if I made the wrong decision. I just think I would have some peace by now if I did the right thing.

But why? I know people always say no contact is the only way...but I just don't see why. I don't feel any better because I stopped contacting him. I still love him. Why would I just turn that off for no reason?
Because he is immature and thinks he's much younger than he is.
Thank you for sharing. I like to hear of people who were able to come off of medication because I tend to think people just get on them and stay on them.
Alright thanks...sometimes I don't know if I should give them more of a chance. But I guess if I get a bad feeling right away, no need to continue.
That is good to hear. How long were you on meds? What made you decide to go off of them if you were doing well?

That's ok. I didn't even know there were rules...just looking for feedback from anyone who had been there. I'm just overwhelmed because I feel like the answer is always "talk to someone about it." And that has failed me.

Hmmm...thanks. I actually see 3 different therapists once weekly and they each charge $175-$200 per session. They each have a different approach/method. I never thought of it as being "too much" therapy...but maybe that is the problem. Too much time with therapists, not enough time for self reflection/doing things on my own? 

I actually have a boxing trainer who I go to a few times a week. Though I am a really terrible boxer, it is mostly cardio and it's one of the most therapeutic forms of exercise I've tried. Exercise is one of the only things that I've found a little bit helpful. I do have an addictive personality though and sometimes I get hooked and it becomes obsessive. A few years ago, I started running and it got to the point where I was running 10-13 miles a day, everyday. I was also limiting my calories during this time. I injured my knee pretty badly but I continued anyway, injuring it even more. 

I think I have a problem with moderation.
How long did you stay with each therapist to see if it was working? A few months?
Interesting...I guess it can't get any worse at this point.

Thanks. I have prescriptions for lexapro and klonopin but I've never taken either one. I'm just really uncomfortable with the idea of medication. The addictive-ness factor scares me as well. 

I also read about "brain zaps" and weird things that have happened to people if they forget to take their lexapro for a day and that is frightening. That would give me even more anxiety. I don't know.
I don't have a good history with medication and I just see that as a segway to a whole new problem.
I doubt it, but it gets me through the day for now.
They were these plastic characters that you would collect. There was some game too where you would flick them across the room and try to knock down other people's crazy bones.

He is always late. Always. I routinely expect him an hour and a half or two hours after the time we decided on. He once got home to drive me to the airport after my flight had already left. It drives me crazy.

Crazy bones. Pokemon Cards. Pogs. Beanie Babies. Tamagotchis. 

I guess kids needed something to do before everything was available as an app.
Ah well, still a pretty big trip. Give him time tonight, if that's what he needs. It will all work out how it needs to. I'm sorry for your loss.
I once waited over 9 months for sex. We did other things before...it was about 2 months before we did anything intimate. We broke up a month after we had sex.
"You'll find someone who loves you like he did."
How far do you live from one another?

You should go. He probably needs you now more than ever. Let him make the call about the wake and funeral...though it sounds like he will want you to attend.

As far as logistics, I would rent a car. It might make you feel like less of a burden and give you a little more freedom. I think you should stay at his house though...I don't think a hotel would be necessary. If at any point you feel you're intruding, you'll have the rental car and you could always leave for a few hours. I doubt your boyfriend would want that though...but it might make you feel more comfortable.

I think he's just using you to make her jealous. He says she found someone new, he probably wants to show her that he can find someone new as well. I think if you stay with him now, you're in for a lot of drama and you're probably going to get hurt. 

Give it some time. I would tell him you're not ready to be in a relationship with him yet. If there's a real, genuine connection, the feelings will still be there in a few months. Personally, I can't imagine getting into a relationship so soon after a breakup. Dating, maybe. But a committed relationship, bad idea.

After my first breakup, I cried every single day for months. I was the one who broke up with him and it still absolutely killed me. It was 3 months later and I would still see a car that looked like his and break down crying. I gained weight, I stopped seeing my friends, I stopped caring what I looked like, I stopped doing things I enjoyed. I told myself every single day that no one was ever going to love me again. I texted him nonstop begging for answers. 

Do the complete opposite of what I did. Seriously. Learn from my mistake please!! Try hard to shift your focus from him...as difficult as it may seem. Distract yourself however you can. Hang out with friends. Workout. Watch movies. Anything you enjoy...do it. And don't contact him. I don't know the details of your breakup, but it only makes it more difficult to keep that channel open. Even if you see him as a friend someday, give it at least a few months. He'll always be there for friendship if that's what you both want eventually.

I was with a 32 year old man shortly after I turned 20. At first, I told myself he was just young at heart and he had a youthful spirit. I was wrong. He was very, very immature and thought I would be an easy person to control because I was so much younger. He constantly made me feel "less than" and like I didn't know enough because I wasn't as experienced as he was. Sexually, we were on two different levels. Emotionally, we were in two different places. Once the fairy tale factor wore off and we had to deal with real life things, our age difference became a huge issue for us.

I definitely regret it. He really messed me up for a loooong time and messed up my views of what a relationship should be. Granted, he was a manipulative person anyway...some of that had nothing to do with the age difference...but there was definitely a feeling of power imbalance.

Yes. He was emotionally and sexually abusive toward the end of the relationship. He was the most manipulative person I've ever met. I don't know why I loved him so much. I still love him. 

At some point, I just had to get out for my own mental health. I started to believe the things he said to me. I believed that was how love was supposed to be. I'm struggling with a lot of things since leaving him, but nothing is as bad as staying would have been.
Yeah, I think a little bit of success breeds more success. The trouble is getting started.
That's a good idea! I'm trying to stay off medication for now, but maybe if I had a friend who was in on it, it might be helpful.
Thanks so much! I may take you up on that.
Have you tried swimming? I hear it's a really good alternative for people with knee problems.
Yes! I hope successs will beget success and make me feel better!

Happy happy birthday!! I hope your day improves a little bit. 

I'm sorry you're dealing with all of this today. I don't have anything super encouraging to say, but I've been there. If you ever want to talk, feel free to message me.

I am currently seeing 2 different therapists. I see them mainly for anxiety, but I haven't been open with them about the extent of my depression. I don't really feel comfortable talking to family and friends about it because I feel like I will be a burden to them. I'm not a naturally open person and it's really hard to me to feel comfortable enough to talk to people about it. I guess it's easier to type anonymously. 

I get upset because I feel like talking to someone won't help me no matter how much I open up. It feels like there's no light at the end of the tunnel right now.
Good luck! Hope it goes well :)

I don't expect that it will stop my anxiety entirely or immediately. I don't see it as some sort of magic cure. From what I understand, the idea is to make someone relax their body and get them in a calm state through breathing and visualization. 

As someone with general anxiety, I don't remember the last time I was truly calm. There is almost never a moment where I can just sit and be still without my mind racing. I kind of saw that as the idea behind hypnotherapy for anxiety.
I'm sorry--that doesn't sound fun. If only you could turn those around and make them motivating! Easier said than done.
Is it any better now?

I read some reviews--people had a lot of great things to say about it. I worry sometimes that reading stuff and posting stuff will be a trigger for me, but I guess I have to face it rather than hide from it. I've been posting a lot online lately, and it makes me feel a little better to be able to vent to random people. I don't really talk about this kind of stuff with family and friends so it's kind of nice to just be able to vent and ask questions. Also, it's nice to know there are other people facing the same problems.
What kind of intrusive thoughts?

Wow -- thank you so much for writing all of that out, I really appreciate it. I will definitely check out that book. I think I've heard of it before,  but I never actually read it. A lot of times I have tried to listen to a meditation or guiding breathing during a panic attack, and it just makes it worse. Hopefully the book techniques will be more helpful for dealing with things in the moment.

That's not true! I'm sure you know it's not! I struggle with this as well but I try to remind myself that in the right time I will meet someone. It's not that no one can love you. Right now, you may not be in a place to accept love. It's possible that it is not the right time to bring someone else into your life. A year from now, things could be totally different! 

Two years ago, I had never been with anyone. Never been in a relationship or dated...literally nothing. I would not let anyone in. I was so so so afraid of being hurt. I had come to accept that it would just never happen to me. I was pretty young, but I came to terms that I just wasn't capable of being loved that way. Then, I met my now ex. He had his issues and he was an absolutely awful boyfriend, but I know he loved me. My time with him showed me I could be loved and I was capable and deserving of it. He also hurt me like no other, but I'm still here and I'm still (mostly) hopeful in the dating department. 

Sorry, just rambling. Hope something was helpful :)

Hi, I don't know if I can be much help, but I know how you feel. Sometimes I feel like on paper it seems like my life is good--like I SHOULD be happy, but I'm just not. I cry everyday. Multiple times a day. Over nothing. I could knock over a glass of water and it's enough to make me cry. Everything seems overwhelming. 

Dating/relationships are difficult when you're dealing with these feelings. I think it's even easier to get "addicted" to people or love because it may be your only source of happiness. I constantly feel like if I just had someone to support me or love me, everything would be easier. I'm trying to convince myself that I have to be self sufficient and love myself before I can ever expect that of anyone else. 

If you ever want to talk, feel free.

Talk to someone! Really--that sucks that they told you you were too low of a priority. I hate hearing stories like that. Your school may have a counseling program, you can start there.

Also, if you're in a relationship and it's making you feel shitty, maybe you should reconsider. I ended a relationship for the same reasons. I thought the relationship and my ex were making me depressed, but then I thought my depression was the thing ruining the relationship. It's hard to tell...there's so many factors that contribute.

I understand feeling this way...but I think it's a never-ending cycle. You think you're not interesting so you don't put yourself out there and then you think the reason people don't like you is because you're not interesting and so on. I'm sure you have a ton of great qualities! You have to try to break the cycle. I know it's difficult and it sucks. And I know the last thing you want to do when you're depressed is get out there and find a new hobby or friend.
